route_categories.DIRECT: A library declaration states the selected conclusion, modulo routine representation adapters.
route_categories.COMPOSITION: Useful library results exist, but at least one substantive source requirement still must be constructed.
route_categories.NO_ROUTE: The current bounded packet exposes no semantically adequate route.

policy.primary_inclusion_rule: Include only tasks for which the current packet exposes useful building blocks without exposing the selected result itself.
policy.result_collision_rule: A direct declaration of the selected conclusion or its source-specific result family excludes the task from the primary marginal-value analysis, even if the declaration carries extra branch hypotheses.
policy.no_route_rule: A NO_ROUTE task is not a primary treatment observation because the protected interface intentionally exposes no NumStability declarations; it may be retained only as a predeclared negative control.

summary.conclusion: The current frozen router does not support an honest 13-task primary campaign. It yields two building-block cases, six possible negative controls, two likely result-collision false negatives, one direct result-family collision, and two topical false positives.

evidence: The highest diagnostic hit, NumStability.higham22_rootUnityVandermonde_eq_fourier, covers a special root-of-unity matrix identity rather than the nodewise structured condition-number limit.
The other leading hits concern generic Frobenius conditioning or an unrelated triangular residual bound.
No exposed card represents the perturbation supremum, its epsilon limit, or the dual-system formula.
tasks.rationale: The current treatment would expose no NumStability API, so this can test null-routing behavior but not marginal library assistance.

The third card is a bidiagonal comparison-matrix identity from Chapter 8.
tasks.rationale: The coupled lexical threshold fires on chapter vocabulary, but none of the three cards supplies the selected inequality. Counting this as routed would introduce search distraction rather than treatment support.
